title: Consulting Engineer - Data Center
description:
**Meet the Team**
 The Customer Experience (CX) team is a group of extraordinary technical professionals dedicated to delivering a best\-in\-class customer experience. We tackle the toughest business challenges with network\-centric solutions that accelerate customer success and loyalty. Our success is reflected in our outstanding financial results, industry recognition, and high employee satisfaction. As the face of Cisco, our CX teams are the primary drivers of digital transformation. Within CX, the Global CX Centers serve as the engine for this transformation, providing flexible, innovative, and highly technical resources to support customer engagements across all theaters. We act as a seamless delivery partner, ensuring our customers achieve their business goals through flawless execution.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Data Center Senior Consulting Engineer, You Will Provide Expert\-level Technical Guidance And Delivery For Our Most High\-profile Global Customers. You Will
   

  

* Design and implement cutting\-edge Cisco technologies for the world’s largest and most complex networks.
* Analyze, monitor, and optimize network performance while automating repeatable tasks.
* Apply innovative technology to solve real\-world business problems and deliver scalable, robust services.
* Develop software and tools to automate manual processes and support infrastructure platforms.
* Act as a strategic partner to our customers, proactively preventing network incidents and providing expert\-level troubleshooting for unique, complex environments.
* Support global field teams and engineers, providing technical leadership and problem\-resolution expertise.
* Conduct internal and external systems/product training and contribute to the development of intellectual property.
* Provide critical feedback to Engineering and Product organizations to influence future product roadmaps.
* Innovate within our service strategy to create new service capabilities and lead service delivery models.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (BS/BE/BTech) or equivalent required; Master’s degree preferred, with 10\+ years of experience in field consulting, technical support services, or a similar role.
* You are a customer\-obsessed problem solver who thrives in team environments.
* Technical Expertise: You possess comprehensive knowledge of Data Center technologies (SDN, SAN, Compute) and Cisco Nexus platforms (2K/5K/7K/9K), including Nexus Standalone and ACI.
* Networking Proficiency: You have deep experience with L2/L3 protocols (vPC, Port Channels, STP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP), VXLAN, and Nexus Dashboard.
* Fabric Management: You demonstrate advanced knowledge of ACI fabric lifecycle management (bring\-up, programmability, QoS, Multicast) and ACI Multi\-Pod/Multi\-Site architectures.
* Automation: You are proficient in NDFC (Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller) and enjoy applying new thinking to automate manual processes.
* Communication: You have strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to influence and work effectively across internal and external organizations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* CCIE (Data Center/Routing \& Switching) or CCNP certification is highly valued.
* Experience or knowledge of virtualization, container technologies such as Kubernetes, AWS, or VMware VCP is a plus.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Ping Federate / MFA – Senior (L3\)**
**Job Summary**
 The Security Analyst/ Security Senior Analyst role will be primarily responsible for the daily operations of monitoring and review of the Access Management application and underlying infrastructure. This role will be responsible for working with end users, vendors, security leads as well as the other support teams to ensure successful operations of the infrastructure.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Incident/Service Request intake and assignment to other teams if required.
* Incident analysis
* Incident triaging
* Change Impact analysis.
* Respond, troubleshoot and implement resolutions for common issues.
* Respond to system outages.
* Maintain Incident remediation and prevention documentation.
* Interact with technical personnel and other teams as required.
* Initiate escalation procedure to resolve incidents.
* Produce service level reports.
* Monitor directory infrastructure for potential issues.
* Monitor backup.
* Coordinate or participate in individual or team projects.
* Write technical articles for internal knowledge base.
* Provide performance metrics as necessary.
* Adhere to stated SLA’s and ensuring high standards for quality regarding project documentation/activities.
* Deploy changes as per the instructions.
* Application validation after changes


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor or college degree in related field or equivalent work experience


**Work Experience**
* 5\-10\-year experience


**Skills Expertise:**
* Basic problem diagnosis, troubleshoot and remediation.
* Must have at least 5 years of relevant experience working on Ping Federate.
* Have experience in installation, implementation, configuration, deployment \& troubleshooting on SSO product \-Ping Federate, PingOne, Ping Access and MFA products – PingID, RSA, Azure MFA etc.
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, Oauth \& OpenID.
* Should have at least 5 years of experience on Access Management product (any product Cloud/On\-Premises products such as Ping Federate \- SSO, MFA Products – PingID, Azure MFA, RSA etc)
* Ability to work on a variety of common technical aspects on Access Management Solution like Version/Patch upgrades, IDP configuration Authentication Policies – Policies, Selectors, Policy Selectors\& Sessions; Identity Profiles; Protocol Endpoints; Oauth Server – Scope Management, Client Registration Policies; Grant Mapping – IDP Adapter Mapping, Authentication Policy Contract Mapping, Resource Owner Credentials Mapping; Token Mapping \- Access Token Management, Access Token Mapping, OpenID Connect Policy Management and application onboarding.
* Experience in managing Certificate \& Key Management.
* Experience on design and development of monitoring scripts, and OGNL expression
* Hands on experience on monitoring tools like Splunk, HP SiteScope, Uptime Robot etc.
* Experience in pre\-activity and post\-activity validation.
* Good verbal \& written communication, technical document writing
* Awareness of global security standards such as PCI, SOX, HIPAA
* Good knowledge of Operating System Internals on Windows/Linux/Unix
* Understands concepts of Authentication, Authorization, Provisioning, Identity and Access Management.
* Good knowledge of basic security concepts.
* Experience of using monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of Service Management / ITIL.
* Prior experience working in remote teams on global scale.


**Certification:**
* ITIL or equivalent (Good to have)
* CIAM/Azure/AWS (Good to have)


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required.
* Willingness to be on call support.
* Willingness to work in shifts.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Assist with the setup and maintenance of local area networks (LANs) and wireless networks.


**Security**

* Monitor systems for security breaches and respond to any incidents.


**Project Participation**
* Assist in IT projects such as rollouts of new hardware or software.
* Collaborate with other IT team members on larger projects.


**Customer Service**
* Provide excellent customer service to ensure user satisfaction.
* Follow up with users to ensure issues are fully resolved.

title: DV360 Policy Product Specialist
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer\-facing role.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience with Google Ads or DV360 (Policy) troubleshooting and processes.
* Experience in online advertising in a customer\-facing role.
* Experience in project management including kicking off workstreams, developing project plans, and collaborating across organizations.
* Experience using Google Ads, the Google Ads product suite, YouTube, or other online advertising systems.
* Analytical skills and experience using insights from data to influence business decisions.
* Effective communication, organizational, customer service, and problem\-solving skills.


**About The Job**
 Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
   

  

 The role is part of the gTech Ads team, which provides media and technical support across the entire Google Ads product stack. This is a full\-time onsite position in the team responsible for accounts policy globally. As a core team member, you will collaborate cross\-functionally to simplify complex ad policies, execute operational readiness plans for new launches, and partner closely with product/platform and trust and safety team to deliver an accurate, frictionless policy experience for advertisers.
   

  

 Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless, customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well\-being, Google provides support for any non\-standard operational shifts.
   

  

 Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. title: Infra Managed Service Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 As an Application Tech Support Practitioner aligned to the ITAM practice, you will be the data\-quality and lifecycle steward for the client's Hardware Asset Management and Configuration Management Database estate on the Now Platform. Your typical day will involve executing Discovery and inventory reconciliation, maintaining asset and CI records, driving HAM workflow tickets (procurement → receive → deploy → maintain → retire → dispose), running CMDB Health remediation, and producing scheduled governance reports. You will work under moderate supervision and own an assigned CI class group or hardware category as the SME to L1 and L3 teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 HAM
   

  

 Execute the end\-to\-end hardware asset lifecycle on ServiceNow HAM/HAM Pro\-on Order, In Stock, In Use, In Maintenance, Retired, Disposed states\-for end\-user devices, data center equipment, network gear, and consumables.
   

  

 Maintain alm\_asset and alm\_hardware records: asset tags, serial numbers, ownership, location, cost\-centre, depreciation, and warranty/lease attributes.
   

  

 Process and fulfil IMAC (Install, Move, Add, Change) tickets, hardware refresh/reclamation, transfer orders between stockrooms, and disposal orders with full audit\-trail documentation.
   

  

 Understand HAM / CMDB normalization concept\-resolve unnormalized models, manufacturer aliases, and EOL/EOSL dates; drive normalization to ≥95% target.
   

  

 Perform scheduled and ad\-hoc inventory audits (including Mobile Agent/barcode scanning); reconcile physical vs. system records and remediate ghost/missing assets.
   

  

 Track lease and warranty data, raise renewals 60\-90 days in advance, and feed refresh planning into Procurement.
   

  

 Maintain stockroom, bundle, consumable, and model\-category data per defined policy.
   

  

 CMDB
   

  

 Maintain CI hygiene across CMDB CI classes within scope.
   

  

 Apply and tune Identification \& Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules\-identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source precedence, and inclusion rules\-for assigned CI classes; resolve duplicate\-CI and overloaded\-CI exceptions.
   

  

 Drive and configure CMDB Health remediation against Completeness, Compliance, and Correctness KPIs in CMDB Workspace; clear orphan/stale/duplicate CI failures before the failure threshold is reached.
   

  

 Configure and process CI attestation, Data Certification, and CMDB Workspace Data Manager retirement/delete policies for stale CIs.
   

  

 Maintain CI relationships per the Common Service Data Model (CSDM 5\.0\)\-Foundation, Ideation \& Strategy, Design \& Planning, Build \& Integration, Service Delivery, Service Consumption, and Manage Portfolios domains.
   

  

 Build and schedule operational reports and Performance Analytics widgets covering CMDB Health %, Hardware Normalization %, Asset Refresh due, Stockroom inventory, and Audit findings.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 3\+ years of hands\-on ServiceNow/others administration with at least 2 years on HAM and/or CMDB.
   

  

 Demonstrated working knowledge of HAM lifecycle states, asset/model/category data model, stockrooms, transfer orders, purchase orders, receiving slips, asset bundles, and disposal orders.
   

  

 Working knowledge of CMDB tables, CI classes, and CSDM concepts.
   

  

 Hands\-on with IRE identification rules, reconciliation rules, and at least one duplicate\-CI deduplication exercise.
   

  

 Working knowledge of CMDB Health (Completeness, Compliance, Correctness) and dashboard remediation.
   

  

 ITIL v4 process awareness\-Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration Management, Service Request.
   

  

 Import Sets/Transform Maps fundamentals; ability to read JavaScript/Glide script for basic edits.
   

  

 Strong written and oral communication in English; ability to run client status calls.
   

  

 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

 ServiceNow Modules
   

  

 HAM, HAM Pro, ITAM, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM, Performance Analytics, Mobile Agent, CMDB Workspace, Hardware Asset Workspace, Now Assist for ITAM (awareness).
   

  

 Educational Qualification:
   

  

 15 years of full\-time education
   

  

 Flexible to work in any shift, including rotational shifts, based on business requirements

title: IAM Operations Engineer
description:
As an
 **IAM Operations Engineer at Topsoe** 
 , you will play a key role in the daily operation, monitoring, support, and troubleshooting of our Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform and its integrations.
   

  

 Your work will help ensure that identity lifecycle processes and access\-management services remain available, reliable, and compliant throughout the employee journey—from
 **joiner to mover to leaver** 
 . You will also help bring IAM platform ownership in\-house as we transition responsibilities from our external partner.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Take ownership of the daily operations of Topsoe’s IAM platform and its integrations.
* Monitor platform health, performance, and connections with enterprise systems such as SAP.
* Handle L2/L3 support escalations from the L1 Service Desk and resolve incidents effectively.
* Troubleshoot provisioning, deprovisioning, access\-request, and access\-review issues.
* Investigate failed or delayed identity transactions and analyze access models and connectors.
* Coordinate complex investigations with development, architecture, application, and infrastructure teams.
* Support testing, deployment, rollback, access reviews, audits, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* You will also help educate L1 support colleagues, improve first\-contact resolution, and maintain clear standard operating procedures and knowledge articles.


**What You Will Bring**
 You have experience operating IAM platforms and supporting identity lifecycle processes in a structured, service\-oriented environment. You are analytical, methodical, and comfortable investigating technical issues with both business and security implications.
   

  

**We Are Looking For**
* Experience operating IAM platforms, preferably SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).
* A good understanding of provisioning flows, connectors, and identity lifecycle processes.
* Experience with IT Service Management, including incident, problem, and change management.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* The ability to prioritize incidents based on business and security impact.
* Clear documentation skills and experience maintaining operational procedures.
* Basic knowledge of APIs and scripting.


**It Would Be An Advantage If You Have**
* SailPoint certification or a willingness to pursue certification.
* Experience working in a global organization with distributed teams.
* Knowledge of monitoring, alerting, and operational performance management.
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar tools.
* An ITIL Foundation certification.
* Experience supporting access reviews, audit controls, or compliance activities.


**Your new team**
 You will join a dedicated internal IAM team of four professionals and help build the foundation for Topsoe’s future IAM operations. Together, the team will take on responsibilities currently managed by our external partner and develop effective ways of working for long\-term operational ownership.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative and security\-focused environment where your work will have a direct impact on Topsoe’s IT landscape.
   

  

**You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Strengthen Topsoe’s internal IAM capabilities.
* Help ensure reliable identity and access services across the organization.
* Improve operational processes, monitoring, and support practices.
* Support the onboarding and stabilization of new applications.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and the development of the IAM team.
* Be part of Topsoe’s ongoing digital transformation.


**How You Can Apply**
 If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
   

  

 Please contact Stefan Schuller, on email sslr@topsoe.com, if you want to know more about the position.

 .
   

  

 You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

 Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

**About The Role**
 As an Associate Engineer\-Security, you will work alongside experienced Network Security Engineers and Service Professionals in a dynamic operational environment and form an integral part of 24\*7 in\-life security support team. You will gain hands\-on exposure to enterprise security platforms, network infrastructure, troubleshooting methodologies, and operational processes used to support global customers.
   

  

 You will support the Network Security team in monitoring, managing, and troubleshooting enterprise network security solutions. You will assist in firewall administration, load balancer operations, VPN support, network security monitoring, incident management, and service delivery activities while developing a strong foundation in network security technologies and best practices.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Firewall Operations: Support the management and monitoring of next\-generation firewalls including Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, and Check Point. Assist with firewall policy reviews, access requests, rule analysis, and configuration validation. Monitor firewall logs and security events to identify network security issues and potential threats.
* Network Security Monitoring: Monitor security alerts, system health, and network events across security platforms. Investigate alerts and support incident resolution activities within agreed service levels. Assist in analysing traffic flows, security logs, and connectivity issues.
* VPN and Secure Connectivity Support: Support administration and troubleshooting of VPN technologies including IPSec VPN, SSL VPN, GlobalProtect, and remote access solutions. Assist users and support teams in resolving secure connectivity issues.
* Incident and Problem Management: Monitor queue across various ITSM platforms (Service Now, NGSD, etc.). Participate in troubleshooting network security incidents and perform preliminary root cause analysis. Support the preparation of incident reports and technical documentation. * Change and Service Management: Support change implementations related to firewalls, load balancers, and security infrastructure. Use ITSM tools such as ServiceNow (SNOW) for incident, request, and change management activities. Ensure all support activities are documented accurately.
* Network Troubleshooting: Assist in troubleshooting routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, and network security issues. Perform log analysis and packet\-flow reviews under guidance from senior engineers.
* Collaboration and Learning: Work closely with network, security, and service management teams. Participate in technical reviews, customer support activities, and operational meetings. Stay updated with emerging technologies, security threats, and industry best practices.

Join our team and start your journey today!

 Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. title: GMS-Senior-Entra SSO
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Cyber Managed Service – Identity and access Management – Senior**
 We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Consultant for Entra SSO Operations to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in identity and access management, with extensive experience in managing and optimizing Entra SSO solutions. This role will involve leading operational initiatives, providing expert guidance, and ensuring the security and efficiency of our SSO environment.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Provide expert L2 and L3 support for Entra SSO\-related issues, including troubleshooting complex user access problems, application integration challenges, and system outages.
* Lead the management of user identities and organizational groups within the Entra SSO platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Oversee the integration of new applications into the Entra SSO environment, collaborating with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor Entra SSO system performance and logs, proactively identifying and addressing potential issues before they impact users and implementing performance optimization strategies.
* Develop and maintain Entra SSO policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices across the organization.
* Experience with App Registration and Enterprise applications
* Conduct regular security reviews and audits of Entra SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements and recommend improvements as necessary.
* Drive the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture and user experience.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained and compliance is achieved.
* Manage the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Entra SSO, prioritizing based on impact and urgency, and mentoring junior staff in troubleshooting techniques.
* Stay updated on new Entra SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform and share insights with the team.
* Provide strategic feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Entra SSO service, including identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements.
* Drive the automation and optimization of operational processes to enhance system reliability and reduce manual workload.
* Mentor junior operations analysts and contribute to the development of training materials and best practices


**Preferred Skills:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience); master’s degree is a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience in IT operations or support, with a focus on identity and access management, specifically with Entra SSO or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of security protocols and standards (e.g., SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect) and their application in SSO environments.
* Proven experience in leading operational initiatives and managing complex technical issues.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in consulting role is preferred, with a track record of delivering high\-quality service to clients.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, ITIL, or similar


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Infra Managed Service Specialist
description:
Job Summary: As the ServiceNow ITAM \& CMDB Application Lead, you will lead the design, build, configuration, and continuous improvement of the client's HAM Pro and CMDB ecosystem on the Now Platform. Your typical day will involve owning the technical design for new HAM lifecycle workflows, governing the CMDB data model under CSDM 5\.0, ratifying IRE identification and reconciliation rules, presiding over CMDB Health KPIs, leading client design workshops, and mentoring a team of 5–15 onshore/offshore practitioners. You are the SME\-expected to take and defend technical decisions for your immediate team and across multiple teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities: Solution Design \& Architecture\-HAM\-CMDB
   

  

 Lead design of ServiceNow HAM Pro lifecycle workflows on Flow Designer\-procurement,receiving,deployment, asset refresh, reclamation, transfer, disposal\-aligned to ServiceNow leading practices and client process design.
   

  

 Govern CMDB design under CSDM 5\.0(7 domains: Foundation, Ideation \& Strategy, Design\&Planning,Build\&Integration, Service Delivery,Service Consumption and Manage Portfolios)map Service Instances, Application Services, Business Applications, and Product Models to client services. Author and ratify IRE identification rules, reconciliation rules, data source precedence rules and inclusion rules across all in\-scope CI classes; sign off deduplication exercises.
   

  

 Define CMDB Health policy in CMDB Workspace Data Manager\-Completeness,Compliance,Correctness \& Staleness windows.
   

  

 Design Discovery architecture\-MID Server placement, credential affinity, IP exclusions, custom patterns, horizontal pattern extension, Cloud Discovery and Service Mapping.
   

  

 Architect integrations between ServiceNow and 3rd\-party sources of truth\-SCCM/MECM, Lansweeper, BMC Helix Discovery, Flexera One, Symphony AI, BDNA, Tanium, JAMF, Intune\-using Service Graph Connectors, Integration Hub spokes, REST/SOAP, transform maps, and ETL. Drive entitlement management strategy where HAM intersects with SAM for hardware\-bound licenses; reconcile install base against entitlement for audit defense.
   

  

 Define hardware normalization governance using the ServiceNow Content Service/Content Library\-manufacturer mapping, model lifecycle, EOL/EOSL/EOSS dates\-to drive normalization
   

  

 Sign off audit and verification framework\-physical audit cadence, sample sizes, Mobile Agent scanning, reconciliation thresholds, and finding remediation SLAs.
   

  

 Where Now Assist for HAM is in scope, design adoption of agentic workflows to automate sourcing, transfer, and procurement of assets upon request.
   

  

 Required Skills:
   

  

 6\+ years overall IT experience with 5\+ years on ServiceNow, of which a minimum 3 years specifically on HAM Pro and/or CMDB design/implementation.
   

  

 Hands\-on design experience with HAM Pro workflows, Hardware Normalization, HAM Workspace, Hardware Asset Audit, Refresh and Reclamation, Stockroom and Transfer Order automation.
   

  

 Hands\-on design experience with CMDB\-CI Class Manager, CMDB Workspace, CSDM,CI relationships, CMDB Health Dashboard, Data Manager, Attestation.
   

  

 Deep IRE expertise\-authoring identification and reconciliation rules; data source precedence configuration; payload design via Identification EngineScriptableApi. createOrUpdateCIEnhanced.
   

  

 Hands\-on Discovery\-MID Server design, custom Discovery patterns and probes, credential strategy, ACLs, troubleshooting Pattern Designer execution.
   

  

 Integration leadership\-Service Graph Connectors, Integration Hub, REST/SOAP/Scripted REST APIs, Import Sets, Transform Maps, ETL transforms, JSON/XML, OAuth 2\.0, Mutual TLS.
   

  

 ServiceNow scripting depth\-JavaScript, Glide API,Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Flow Designer.
   

  

 ITIL 4 process leadership\-owns Configuration Management process design conversations with the client.
   

  

 Strong client\-facing communication\-runs CXO\-level governance, writes board\-grade decks, defends design under audit/regulatory scrutiny.
   

  

 Flexible to work in any shift, including rotational shifts, based on business requirements

**About The Role**
 Our purpose is to use the power of communication to make a better world. For each other, for our customers, for society and our communities.
   

  

 The team provides 2nd line diagnostic support and managed services to our customers through the use of routing, switching, wireless technologies and products, 24x7x365 days a year. By using market leading products and applying BTs process, quality and intellectual property, we provide our customers with services to facilitate their objectives through the power of communication.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Act as the frontline operational contact for network\-related incidents, service requests, and operational activities.
   

  

 Provide 2nd Line support for BT Enterprise networking services, ensuring delivery within agreed SLAs.
   

  

 Own and resolve complex incidents, service requests, problems and escalations.
   

  

 Perform troubleshooting, fault diagnosis and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) across customer environments.
   

  

 Manage tickets and customer communications through SNOW, NGSD and associated systems.
   

  

 Execute technical changes, impact assessments, risk reviews and peer reviews in line with BT change governance.
   

  

 Collaborate with customers, vendors and internal teams to drive service restoration and issue resolution.
   

  

 Produce technical documentation, RCA reports and customer updates.
   

  

 Support software upgrades, patching and platform maintenance activities.
   

  

 Drive continuous improvement, process standardisation and operational excellence.
   

  

 Share knowledge, mentor colleagues and contribute to team capability development.
   

  

**Essential Skills / Experience**
 CCNA certification is good to have.
   

  

 Experience supporting LAN, WAN, Wireless and SD\-WAN environments.
   

  

 Basic knowledge of Cisco, Meraki, TCP/IP, Routing Protocols and QoS.
   

  

 Experience with ServiceNow (SNOW), NGSD and ITSM ticketing tools.
   

  

 Strong knowledge into AI along with Python and Ansible.
   

  

 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Strong customer, stakeholder and communication skills.
   

  

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
 CCNA Certification
   

  

 SDWAN Knowledge
   

  

 ServiceNow tool/ SNOW
   

  

 BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
   

  

 BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
   

  

 Having come through the most capital\-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

 Service Delivery Manager (SDM) ? US Region, SAP S/4HANA AMS

Instead, the role requires a practitioner\-level understanding of SAP S/4HANA (or an equivalent ERP platform) gained through experience across multiple functional workstreams, so that the SDM can assess incident content, challenge and validate the offshore team's analysis, and make sound prioritization and solution decisions. Depth in a subset of workstreams is acceptable, provided the candidate can operate credibly across the broader end\-to\-end process landscape. The US region is also expecting multiple new site go\-lives beginning next year, so the SDM must be equally comfortable running steady\-state operations for existing live sites and supporting cutover/hypercare activity for new sites ? in parallel.
   

  

 The SDM's Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To, The Following (evaluation Criteria, Contract Terms, And SLA/KPI Details Are Outside The Scope Of This JD):
   

  

* Incident / Request Oversight (L2/L3 Functional Judgment):
* Review and interpret SAP S/4HANA incidents and service requests at a functional level, assess business impact and priority, and direct them to the right resolver group with clear context ? hands\-on configuration or development is performed by the AMS delivery team.

* Daily Communication \& Deliverable Management:

* Review deliverables submitted by the offshore team to confirm they meet regional quality standards before closure.

* Clearly explain offshore\-provided solutions and deliverables to US business users and stakeholders.

* Enforce ITSM process discipline (ticket categorization, SLA adherence, documentation) across Incident, Problem, and Change Management practices.

* Ticket Trend Analysis \& Continuous Improvement:
* Analyze historical ticket data to identify recurring issues and process bottlenecks.

* Parallel Go\-Live Support (New Site Rollout):

 SAP S/4HANA AMS

 ERP Functional
   

  

 Experience (7\+ years,
   

  

 Multi\-Workstream) 7\+ years of SAP (or equivalent enterprise ERP) functional experience covering multiple workstreams ? for example Record\-to\-Report (FI/CO), Order\-to\-Cash (SD), Procure\-to\-Pay (MM), Plan\-to\-Deliver (PP/QM), or Warehouse Management (EWM). Coverage of every module is not required; deep experience in some areas combined with working

 Functional Judgment
   

  

 \& Solution Validation Ability to interpret L2/L3 incident content, guide and challenge root cause analysis, and validate proposed solutions ? i.e., substantive functional judgment rather than ticket routing alone. Self\-performed configuration or development is not required.
   

  

 Offshore/Global

 ITSM Process

 Escalation \&

title: Sr Professional Services Consultant (PSC)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Your Career As a Professional Services Consultant, you will be a pivotal technical expert, spearheading the successful deployment and initial configuration of our Prisma Access Browser (PAB) solution for customers. This is a highly impactful, hands\-on role where you will directly translate customer security requirements into a fully operational and optimized cloud\-delivered browser security solution. Working closely with customers, solution consultants, and project managers, you will implement PAB according to best practices and customer\-specific needs. Beyond deployment, you will be a proactive driver, navigating complex environments, anticipating roadblocks, and accelerating our customers' journey to a Zero Trust architecture. You will solidify customer partnerships with Palo Alto Networks by ensuring they successfully adopt and maximize the value of PAB. If you thrive on technical challenges, leading complex deployments, and being the face of strategic, results\-driven implementation, this is your next career move. Your Impact Proactively Drive Technical Deployment: Execute the complete technical lifecycle of PAB implementation, including secure tenant setup and complex Identity Provider (IdP) integrations. Take ownership of the deployment timeline, proactively managing and overcoming any customer hesitations or delays to ensure rapid time\-to\-value Translate Strategy to Security Policy: Convert customer business and security designs into practical, effective PAB configurations, focusing on access controls, data loss prevention (DLP) rules, and web security policies Drive Adoption: Guide customers through the secure and large\-scale deployment of the PAB extension/client to end\-user devices using various enterprise deployment methods (e.g., GPO, MDM) Be a Proactive Technical Advisor: Serve as the go\-to expert for PAB best practices, advanced feature utilization, and performance tuning, actively monitoring environments to pre\-emptively identify, recommend, and resolve potential issues or areas for security posture improvement Resolve Complex Escalations: Act as the primary technical escalation point, performing deep\-dive root cause analysis and coordinating across Support, Engineering, and Product teams for timely resolution Document and Transfer Knowledge: Create high\-quality, customer\-specific "as\-built" documentation and deliver comprehensive operational training and knowledge transfer to customer administrators Advocate for the Customer: Capture and translate valuable field feedback into actionable feature requests, serving as a critical internal voice for product improvement and development Maintain expert\-level understanding of Prisma Access Browser: Stay updated on latest product releases, security trends, and industry best practices. Actively participate in relevant training and certification programs to maintain technical proficiency
   

  

**Qualifications (Additional Job Description)**
 Your Experience 8\+ years of experience required in a hands\-on, technical, customer\-facing role such as Professional Services Consultant, Technical Account Manager, or Senior Sales Engineer Proven track record of proactive engagement; the ability to take initiative to push customers toward successful deployment, manage project risks, and navigate organizational challenges or pushback to maintain project velocity Expert\-level knowledge of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S) and enterprise security principles (Zero Trust, SASE, Firewall, Proxy, VPN) Demonstrated ability to independently lead and execute complex technical projects in customer environments, driving deployment to successful completion Advanced analytical and troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to identifying, diagnosing, and resolving technical issues (Root Cause Analysis) Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to convey complex security topics to diverse technical and non\-technical stakeholders Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and authentication protocols, specifically integrating solutions with IdPs like Azure AD or Okta using SAML 2\.0 Familiarity with cloud and SaaS security architecture and the challenges associated with securing modern applications and browsers Knowledge of Prisma Access deployment, architecture, and traffic flows These skills are desired and will be prioritized, accelerating time\-to\-value in the role: Basic knowledge of enterprise tools for large\-scale device deployment (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, SCCM) Industry certifications such as Palo Alto Networks (PCNSA, PCNSE), CISSP, or cloud\-specific security certifications Basic scripting ability (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for automation or data manipulation
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com .
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Manager - IT, Security, and Cloud
description:
**5–7 Years \| Gurgaon \| Full\-Time**
**Company:** 
 iDream Education
   

  

**Location:** 
 Sector 32, Gurgaon
   

  

**Role type:** 
 Full\-time, Work from Office
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5–7 years of direct and relevant experience with end\-to\-end ownership of IT infrastructure, security, and operations
   

  

**Industry Preference:** 
 EdTech, Education SaaS, Social Impact / Development Sector, or purpose\-led B2B/B2G organisations
   

  

* About iDream Education


**Vision:** 
 Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.
   

  

**Belief:** 
 We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being's fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.
   

  

**Mission:** 
 To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio\-economic status.
   

  

**Education**
 iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline \& online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum\-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:
   

  

* iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms
* iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs
* iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning
* iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring
* iPrep App for a one\-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and Web


 Through iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to
 **Learn Unlimited** 
 .
   

  

 Company website:
 **www.idreameducation.org**
 iPrep website:
 **www.iprep.in**
* Role Summary


 We are looking for an IT Lead — someone who will be the single point of ownership for everything IT at iDream Education. This is not a narrow infrastructure or helpdesk role; it is a domain\-ownership role spanning internal systems, network and cloud infrastructure, our field\-deployed device fleet (iPrep Tablets and other hardware), data security, and compliance.
   

  

 You will be the person who ensures our internal teams never lose a working day to IT friction, and who ensures thousands of devices deployed across schools and NGOs in rural India stay secure, tracked, and functional. You will also be the one building the IT function itself — starting hands\-on, and growing it into a proper team as iDream scales.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities \& Deliverables


**IT Infrastructure, Systems \& Support**
* Own and manage all internal IT infrastructure — networks, servers, cloud services, and systems administration — ensuring uptime, reliability, and security across office operations.
* Run IT helpdesk and support for all employees, ensuring fast turnaround on hardware, software, and access\-related issues.
* Own vendor relationships for hardware, software licenses, ISPs, cloud providers, and AMC contracts — negotiating terms, managing renewals, and controlling IT spend.


**Device \& Field Hardware Fleet Management**
* Own the full lifecycle of iPrep Tablets and other field\-deployed hardware — procurement, provisioning, tracking, maintenance, and end\-of\-life — across schools and NGO locations.
* Build and maintain systems for remote monitoring, troubleshooting, and updates of devices deployed at scale in low\-connectivity environments.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure hardware compatibility with new iPrep software releases and rollouts.


**Data Security \& Compliance**
* Own information security practices across the organisation — access controls, data backup, endpoint security, and incident response.
* Ensure the organisation's data handling practices align with DPDPA 2023 and other applicable data protection requirements.
* Conduct periodic security audits and risk assessments, and build/maintain IT policies, SOPs, and documentation.


**AI\-First IT Operations:** 
 Bring AI\-augmented workflows into IT operations — from automated monitoring and alerting to AI\-assisted troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — keeping iDream's IT stack modern and lean.
   

  

* Qualifications \& Experience


**Experience:** 
 5–7 years in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or IT operations, with demonstrable ownership across networks, hardware/device management, and security — ideally including experience managing hardware deployed outside a single office (field, retail, or distributed environments).
   

  

**Sector Context:** 
 Experience in EdTech, the Development sector, or mission\-driven B2B/B2G environments is a strong advantage. Experience managing device fleets in low\-bandwidth or rural contexts is a plus.
   

  

**Technical Proficiency:** 
 Strong grounding in networking, systems administration (Windows/Linux), cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and device/MDM (mobile device management) tools.
   

  

**Security \& Compliance:** 
 Working knowledge of IT security fundamentals and data protection principles, including familiarity with DPDPA 2023\.
   

  

**Vendor \& Budget Management:** 
 Proven experience managing vendor contracts, AMC negotiations, and IT budgets.
   

  

**AI Fluency:** 
 You use AI tools as a daily productivity layer for monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and reporting — not as a novelty.
   

  

* Key Skills \& Competencies


**What Makes You a Great Fit?**
 You think in systems, not tickets. You've owned IT for an organisation before — not just responded to issues as they came in — and you know how to build infrastructure and processes that scale without breaking. You're equally comfortable troubleshooting a server issue and thinking through how thousands of tablets in rural India stay secure and functional. You're excited about using AI to make IT operations faster and leaner, and you've already started building that into how you work.
   

  

* What We're Looking For — Values \& Culture Fit
* Integrity: Takes ownership of IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection with transparency, accountability, and strong ethical standards.
* Excellence: Builds reliable, secure, scalable, and AI\-enabled IT systems while continuously improving infrastructure, processes, and support.
* Collaboration: Works effectively with internal teams, vendors, and technology partners to ensure seamless IT operations and successful hardware and system deployments.
* Impact: Enables uninterrupted business operations and ensures secure, reliable technology reaches teams, schools, and last\-mile learners at scale.
* Why Join Us


 We are on a mission to take the best of digital learning to every corner of rural Bharat. At iDream, you will have the opportunity to build and own the IT function from the ground up — one that keeps our teams productive and our technology reaching the last\-mile learner securely and reliably.
   

  

* Required Skills (Portal Tags)


 Network Administration, Systems Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, IT Security, Device/MDM Management, Vendor Management, Data Protection Compliance, Decision Making, Analytical Skills

title: Exchange Online Administrator
description:
Our Company
   

  

 We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast\-moving digital transformation market.
   

  

 Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full\-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real\-world impact for our customers and society as a whole.
   

  

 Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement – your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Role**
* Design, deploy, and manage Exchange Online within Microsoft 365\.
* Administer, configure, and maintain Exchange Online services.
* Handle mailbox management, permissions, and troubleshooting.
* Manage mail flow, connectors, and transport rules.
* Configure anti\-spam, anti\-malware, and phishing protection policies.
* Implement and manage retention policies, legal holds, and eDiscovery.
* Perform advanced message tracing and diagnostics
* Maintain and support Teams environment including channels, permissions, and policies.
* Configure Teams governance and compliance settings.
* Administer OneDrive for Business and provide support for SharePoint Online (nice to have).
* Manage user accounts, permissions, and security configurations in Azure Active Directory
* Ensure compliance with organizational security and governance standards.


**What You’ll Bring**
* 8\+ years of experience in Microsoft 365 administration with strong focus on Exchange Online and Teams.
* Deep knowledge of mail flow, transport rules, and security policies.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure AD identity and access management.
* Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for complex messaging environments.
* Familiarity with retention policies, legal holds, and eDiscovery processes.
* Experience in managing Teams governance and collaboration policies.
* Knowledge of OneDrive and SharePoint Online administration is a plus.


**Preferred Attributes**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and in cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise\-scale Microsoft 365 environments.


**About Us**
 We're a global, 1000\-strong, diverse team of professional experts, promoting and delivering Social Innovation through our One Hitachi initiative (OT x IT x Product) and working on projects that have a real\-world impact. We're curious, passionate and empowered, blending our legacy of 110 years of innovation with our shaping our future. Here you're not just another employee; you're part of a tradition of excellence and a community working towards creating a digital future.
   

  

 Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives
   

  

 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

 How we look after you
   

  

 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you'll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
   

  

*We're proud to say we're an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic.* 
 Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Since our founding in 1996, Numerix has been at the vanguard of financial technology, providing quantitative analytics and software that redefine pricing and risk management across the financial markets. Through recent strategic acquisitions, Numerix has further strengthened its leadership position, empowering financial institutions worldwide to transform risk into opportunity with confidence. As AI reshapes capital markets technology, Numerix is focused on combining the speed and flexibility of AI with the deterministic, auditable, and governed calculations that financial institutions require.
   

  

 The
 **Salesforce Administrator** 
 is responsible for the administration of the Numerix Salesforce.com org. Salesforce.com is our primary system of records for sales and service teams. As the Salesforce Administrator, you will configure, integrate, administer, train, and support end users on the Salesforce platform.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Administer and maintain the Salesforce CRM platform, ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations.
* Manage and configure Salesforce CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) applications to streamline sales processes.
* Manage user accounts, create and update \- profiles, validation rules, flows, process builders, reports and dashboards in Salesforce.
* Establish or adjust assignment rules, escalation rules, auto response rules, queues, fields, objects and formulas by closely collaborating with stakeholders such as sales, service and marketing teams.
* Participate in the discovery of data from various internal sources and the creation of reports and dashboards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Salesforce platform issues, working closely with stakeholders.
* Perform data quality checks and data cleansing tasks to ensure accurate records.
* Support and maintain integration between Salesforce and other business systems.
* Train and support end users on new or existing internal and third\-party software systems and processes.
* Conduct appropriate analysis of existing Salesforce data to help identify patterns and aid in data quality improvements.
* Research and recommend third\-party applications to enhance the operational efficiency of business users on the Salesforce platform.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and IT teams to understand business requirements and implement tailored solutions.
* Monitor Salesforce releases and apply new features to keep the system updated.
* Provide recommendations for process improvements based on analysis of Salesforce data.


**What We're Looking for:**
* BS in Computer Science or Information Technology.
* 3\+ years’ experience in Salesforce CRM and CPQ administration. Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201\) certification is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce CPQ, including product rules, pricing, quoting, and discounting structures.
* Experience in Salesforce platform customization and configuration, working with platform objects, fields and layouts.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce CPQ, including product rules, pricing, quoting, and discounting structures.
* Experience in re\-engineering or updating an existing Salesforce org.
* Basic data science skills with proficiency in building reports and dashboards for business users.
* Ability to make independent decisions and assist in developing creative solutions to support business strategies.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with proven ability to gather and decipher information from business users.
* Experience preparing and delivering training to staff.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Adhere to work timings: 1:30PM – 10:30PM IST (Indian Standard Hours).


**Extra Credit:**
* Salesforce CPQ Specialist Certification.
* 100 Trailhead Badges and multiple Superbadges.
* Exposure to Data Visualization tools like PowerBI/Tableau.
* Familiarity with Apex and Visualforce (basic understanding).
* Experience with third\-party Salesforce integrations and tools.
* Experience in user training and documentation.
* Strong interest in pursuing other SF certs.


**Where you'll work:**
 This is a remote role, open to all who reside within India.
   

  

**An important note on language:**
 We will only consider CVs written in English. All interviews will be conducted in English, and candidates must demonstrate business fluency in the language.
   

  

**An important note on salary:**
 The annual pay range for this position is based on the preferred primary location of the role which is listed above. If you are applying to this role at a location that is not the preferred primary location, please keep in mind the salary range will vary and may fall outside of what is listed. Base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
   

  

***Also note that unsolicited contact from third\-party recruiters or agencies will not be considered at this time. We respectfully request no outreach from agencies.***

title: Diploma Freshers – Server & Workstation Assembly
description:
**Company Description** 
 Viewpixel Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian OEM company specializing in the assembly, integration, and supply of Servers, Storage Solutions, Workstations, and Large Format Displays under the Make in India initiative. The company delivers high\-quality, reliable, and scalable technology solutions that meet domestic and global standards, supported by strong in\-house assembly and testing capabilities. Viewpixel provides custom\-built systems tailored to specific application and performance requirements, engineered for mission\-critical environments to ensure durability and long\-term efficiency. Its solutions support sectors such as Indian Railways, Airports, Government and PSUs, corporate enterprises, education, healthcare, and industrial infrastructure projects. With a strong focus on quality, compliance, and dependable after\-sales support, Viewpixel enables customers to achieve operational excellence using trusted Made\-in\-India technology.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Delhi for Diploma Freshers – Server \& Workstation Assembly. The role involves assisting in the assembly, installation, and basic configuration of servers, workstations, and related hardware components as per company standards. Daily tasks include handling components, following assembly checklists, supporting testing procedures, and maintaining accurate records of assembled units. The candidate will work closely with the production and quality teams to ensure that all systems meet performance and safety requirements. The role also includes maintaining a clean and organized work area, following ESD and safety guidelines, and cooperating with senior technicians and engineers for continuous learning and process improvement.

* Diploma in Electronics, Computer Science, Electrical, or a related technical discipline.
* Basic understanding of computer hardware components (motherboards, processors, memory, storage, power supplies) and their functions.

* Good teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in a fast\-paced production environment.

title: GMS-Staff-SSO-MFA
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**GDS – IAM MS– Staff**
 The SSO \& Access Management Staff are responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of enterprise Single Sign\-On (SSO) and Access Management platforms. This role involves application onboarding, incident and request management, user access administration, authentication troubleshooting, and platform monitoring activities.
   

  

 The individual will work with leading access management technologies such as Okta, PingFederate, Ping One, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and related authentication and federation solutions, while ensuring secure and reliable access to enterprise applications.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Support the administration and maintenance of enterprise SSO and Access Management platforms including Okta, PingFederate or similar technologies.
* Provide L2/L2\.5 operational support for authentication, authorization, SSO, MFA, and access\-related incidents and requests.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta or Ping platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the SSO environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor SSO system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta or Ping Federate, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the SSO service, including automation opportunities.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Good understanding of identity and access management concepts.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Okta, Ping Federate or related technologies
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts as required

* Serve as the primary interface with internal leaders, external business partners, vendors, and contractors, aligning priorities and resolving operational or systemic issues

description:
Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly and professionally.
* Solid computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and comfort learning new business platforms quickly.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when working with records, documentation, and consumer data.
* Ability to follow defined procedures, meet deadlines, and work within a regulated, compliance\-focused environment.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive consumer information.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, India, on assigned shifts, and to collaborate with operations, compliance, and management teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in BPO, collections, financial services, customer service, quality assurance, audit, or systems administration is an advantage.
* Function\-specific experience is preferred but not required: dispute handling or complaints for Consumer Disputes; high\-volume data processing for Data Entry; LMS or training coordination for LMS Admin; QA scorecards or call monitoring for Quality Call Scoring; audit or controls testing for Internal Audit Testwork; monitoring tools, ticketing, or basic SQL for System Monitoring Admin.



 Please indicate your preferred function or functions in your application.
